description: This file contains JavaScript code for client-side validation and UI interactions in the vtiger CRM system, including message box handling, mandatory field validation, and field data validation.

classes.name: VTFieldValidator
classes.description: A class for managing validation of form fields, including adding validators and performing validation checks.

methods.name: MessageBoxPopup
methods.description: Function that creates a popup message box with show and close functionalities.

methods.name: validateMandatoryFields.init
methods.description: Initializes the list of mandatory fields.

methods.name: validateMandatoryFields.validator
methods.description: Validates that all mandatory fields are filled.

methods.name: validateFieldData.init
methods.description: Initializes validation functions for different data types.

methods.name: validateFieldData.validator
methods.description: Validates fields based on their data types, such as email, integer, date, time, etc.

methods.name: VTFieldValidator.prototype.validate
methods.description: Performs validation using all added validators and shows message box if validation fails.

methods.name: VTFieldValidator.prototype.addValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator to the list of validators.

methods.name: VTFieldValidator.prototype.fieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a form field by name.

methods.name: VTFieldValidator
methods.description: Constructor function for creating a validator object for a form.
